title: DUET: Dual Clustering Enhanced Multivariate Time Series Forecasting

problem.claim: Multivariate time series forecasting supports applications including financial investment, energy management, weather forecasting, and traffic optimization.

gap.claim: Accurate forecasting is challenged by heterogeneous temporal patterns caused by distribution shifts over time and by complex, intertwined correlations among channels that are difficult to model precisely and flexibly.

narrative_sequence.summary: Multivariate time series forecasting is important across multiple application areas.
Accurate forecasting faces two main challenges.
Real-world series may exhibit heterogeneous temporal patterns due to distribution shifts over time.
Complex and intertwined channel correlations make precise and flexible interaction modeling difficult.

source_observation.claim: Forecasting systems must account for temporal heterogeneity associated with distribution shifts.

interpretation.claim: A single stationary temporal-pattern assumption may be insufficient for real-world multivariate forecasting.

application.claim: When designing forecasting methods, consider mechanisms that can represent changing temporal patterns over time.

exception.claim: The supplied abstract units do not establish that this consideration improves forecasting accuracy in any specific setting.

unknowns: The proposed method and its specific clustering mechanisms are not described.
No datasets, baselines, metrics, quantitative results, or experimental conditions are supplied.
The abstract units do not state an explicit novel contribution.
